top_signals.title: StanChart Sees Higher Oil Floor as Hormuz Crisis Spreads to Saudi Export Routes
top_signals.summary: Oil prices pulled back but remained elevated ahead of a critical Fed decision on Wednesday, with market expectations shifting towards a prolonged US-Iran conflict. Brent crude for November delivery fell 2.88% at 2:18 p.m. ET, to trade at $105.6 per barrel, while WTI crude for October delivery declined 3.33% to change hands at $102.3/bbl. The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points on Wednesday to a range of 3.75% to 4.00%, its first rate hike since 2023, as policymakers responded to renewed inflationary pressure. top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BOE Expected to Keep Rates Unchanged
top_signals.summary: The Bank of England is expected to hold interest rates as it waits for more evidence that a fresh bout of inflation risks a damaging wage-price spiral. Economists and investors expect the Monetary Policy Committee to leave the benchmark cost of borrowing at 3.75%, where it’s been since December last year. Matthew Bunny, UK economist at Bloomberg Economics, breaks down the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The Japan Times to hold its first school fair in Taiwan, showcasing Japan-based boarding and international schools
top_signals.summary: The Japan Times, Ltd. (Head office: Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo; Chairperson and Publisher: Minako Suematsu) will hold The Japan Times School Fair Taipei, bringing together boarding schools and international schools based in Japan, in Taipei, Taiwan, on Sunday, Oct. 11, 2026. The event will be the company’s first school fair held outside Japan, and registration is now open.

top_signals.title: The Japan Times が、日本のボーディングスクール・インターナショナルスクールを紹介するスクールフェアを台湾で初開催！
top_signals.summary: 株式会社ジャパンタイムズ（本社：東京都千代田区、代表取締役会長兼社長：末松弥奈子）は、日本国内のボーディングスクールおよびインターナショナルスクールが参加する「The Japan Times School Fair Taipei」を、2026年10月11日（日）、台湾・台北で開催します。本イベントは、当社が海外で開催する初のスクールフェアで、現在、来場登録を受け付けています。
